description:
Highlights

Exceptional Four-Bedroom, Four-Bathroom Family Home
Superb Position Overlooking a Large Open Green
Private, South-Facing Rear Garden – Not Overlooked
Spacious Accommodation Across Three Floors
Two Bedrooms with Ensuite Facilities
Two Designated Car Parking Spaces
EV Car Charging Point
Gas-Fired Central Heating with Hive Controls
Large Patio Area – Ideal for Al Fresco Dining
Wooden Shutters to All Front-Facing Rooms and Wooden Venetian Blinds to All Rear Facing Rooms
Excellent Storage Throughout 
Excellent Transport Links Including M50

Premium Collection LWK Group are delighted to introduce this exceptional four-bedroom, four-bathroom family home to the market. Beautifully presented and maintained by the current owners, this impressive property enjoys a superb position within the highly regarded Stocking Wood development, overlooking a large open green to the front and benefiting from a particularly attractive south-facing rear garden which is private and not overlooked.

Extending to three spacious floors, the property offers generous and exceptionally well-balanced accommodation, making it an ideal choice for modern family living. The combination of its excellent proportions, four bathrooms, wonderful green outlook and private south-facing garden creates a home of genuine quality and appeal.

On entering, a bright and welcoming hallway leads to the contemporary kitchen/dining room positioned to the front of the property.  The space benefits from practical under-stairs storage compartments, offering excellent everyday storage solutions. This well-appointed kitchen/dining space enjoys pleasant views over the adjoining green and mature landscaping, with excellent storage and integrated appliances. To the rear, the spacious living room is a particularly impressive feature, beautifully finished with solid wood flooring and a feature fireplace. French doors open directly onto the large patio and private south-facing rear garden, creating a superb connection between the living and outdoor spaces and providing an ideal setting for entertaining, outdoor dining and relaxing.

A stylish guest WC completes the ground floor accommodation.

The first floor provides three well-proportioned bedrooms all with built-in wardrobes, including a generous double bedroom with its own ensuite and pumped shower room. Two further bedrooms, including a versatile single bedroom, are served by a beautifully upgraded family bathroom.

The entire second floor is dedicated to the impressive principal bedroom suite. Exceptionally spacious and filled with natural light, this wonderful room enjoys views over the adjoining green and across Dublin beyond. The bedroom benefits from fitted wardrobes, feature lighting, carpet flooring and a stylish ensuite shower room with rainfall shower. Convenient access to the attic provides additional storage potential.

Externally, the property continues to impress. To the front are two designated parking spaces, together with an EV car charging point. To the rear is a particularly attractive south-facing garden which enjoys an excellent degree of privacy and is not overlooked. The generous patio area provides an ideal space for al fresco dining, while the garden also benefits from a useful storage shed.

This is a superb family home that combines generous accommodation with an enviable position and excellent outdoor space. The green outlook to the front, private south-facing garden to the rear, three-floor accommodation, four bathrooms and excellent parking provision make this a particularly attractive proposition for purchasers seeking a high-quality home in a well-established residential setting.

Stocking Wood is superbly positioned at the foothills of the Dublin Mountains, offering an excellent balance of convenience, recreation and family amenities. The development enjoys easy access to the M50 and is well served by regular bus routes providing convenient connections towards Dublin city centre.

A wide range of shopping and everyday amenities are close by, including the shopping centre on Stocking Avenue, Woodstown Shopping Centre, Knocklyon Shopping Centre and Rathfarnham Shopping Centre which further enhance the convenience and appeal of this already highly sought-after location. For outdoor enthusiasts, Marlay Park, Cruagh Woods and the Hellfire Club are all within easy reach.

Families are exceptionally well catered for, with a selection of highly regarded primary and secondary schools in the surrounding area, including St. Colmcille's Community School, Loreto Beaufort and Templeogue College. 

In summary, 1 Stocking Wood Green represents a superb opportunity to acquire a beautifully presented four-bedroom, four-bathroom family home with two parking spaces, EV charging, a wonderful family friendly green outlook and a private south-facing rear garden — all within one of South Dublin's most popular residential locations.

Accommodation

 1.80m x 5.90m
A bright and welcoming entrance hall featuring elegant tiled flooring and excellent under-stairs storage, providing a practical and attractive introduction to the home.

Guest WC – 1.49m x 1.43m
Well-presented guest WC featuring tiled flooring, WC and wash hand basin. 

Kitchen/Dining Room – 3.50m x 5.50m

A bright and contemporary kitchen/dining space positioned to the front of the property and overlooking the pleasant green area. The kitchen offers excellent storage and integrated appliances, while the dining area provides an ideal setting for family meals and entertaining.

Living Room – 4.80m x 3.80m
A spacious and beautifully finished reception room featuring solid wood flooring and a feature fireplace. Sliding patio doors provide direct access to the large patio and private south-facing rear garden.

Bedroom 1 – 3.30m x 3.50m
A generous double bedroom enjoying a pleasant outlook over the adjoining green and mature trees. Built-in wardrobes provide excellent storage, while the room also benefits from a well-appointed ensuite shower room.

Ensuite – 1.40m x 2.60m
Tiled ensuite shower room with WC and wash hand basin.

Bedroom 2 – 2.30m x 3.50m
A well-proportioned double bedroom featuring fitted wardrobes.

Bedroom 3 – 2.30m x 3.00m
A versatile single bedroom with fitted storage, making it ideal as a child's bedroom, guest room, study or home office.

Bedroom 4 / Principal Bedroom – 4.30m x 7.40m
An impressive second-floor principal bedroom enjoying a wonderful outlook over the nearby green and across Dublin beyond. Beautifully presented with carpet flooring, feature lighting and extensive fitted wardrobes. The room benefits from a stylish ensuite shower room and convenient attic access.

Ensuite – 2.60m x 1.50m
Stylish ensuite shower room featuring tiled flooring, WC, wash hand basin and a generous shower with rainfall shower head.

Family Bathroom – 2.80m x 2.50m
Beautifully appointed family bathroom finished with stylish wall and floor tiling. The suite comprises WC, wash hand basin with integrated storage, heated towel rail and bath with shower attachment.
